rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for something adjacent or close by.
This is the all-purpose spoken choice for saying that someone or something is located nearby.

example.jyutping: ngo5 uk1 kei2 hai2 fu6 gan6

rows.note: Use this pattern when saying that an action such as living or staying happens close to someone or somewhere else.

example.english: We live nearby, close to the office.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zyu6 dak1 gan6 gung1 si1
